personality: 7 Dark-First Utility fused with 4 Tactile / Playful
personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, responsive puzzle environment prioritizing immediate tactile feedback, vibrant jewel-toned blocks, and a focused slate-dark background.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical spacing between board and tray to prevent accidental touches. Board padding tight to maximize grid size.

dont's: Do not use blur for blocks or board, maintain solid performance-first rendering.

screens.name: Game
screens.purpose: Core gameplay loop consisting of a score header, an 8x8 matrix board, a 3-slot piece tray, and a placeholder ad banner at the bottom.

states.empty: N/A - Game always renders a state

screens.layout: Vertical Layout. Top: Score on left, Best Score (with Crown icon) on right. Middle: 8x8 Grid (filling width minus safe margins). Bottom: Tray displaying 3 spawnable block clusters. Footer: Placeholder Ad Banner anchored to the bottom edge. Modal overlay for Game Over with placeholder ad spot.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement an 8x8 grid as a 2D array state.
Use react-native-reanimated and react-native-gesture-handler for dragging pieces from the tray onto the board.

Render block pieces with a tactile 3D bevel. This can be achieved natively without images by applying a light top/left border (rgba(255,255,255,0.3)) and a dark bottom/right border (rgba(0,0,0,0.3)) on each cell of a block.
When dragging a piece over the board, implement a 'ghost' preview showing where it will land if valid.
Animate row/column clears by scaling down or flashing the cells before removing them, accompanied by a 'heavy' haptic.
Combo text ('Great!', 'Excellent!') should pop up over the board using Reanimated, scaling from 0 to 1, then fading out moving upwards.
Include a 'Game Over' overlay that pauses interaction, displays final score, provides a restart button, and leaves a dedicated block for an Interstitial/Banner Ad slot.
Place a permanent Banner Ad placeholder view at the very bottom edge of the screen below the piece tray.
Add a simple Settings icon in the header that opens a bottom sheet to toggle Sounds and Haptics.
Make sure touch targets for dragging pieces from the bottom tray are oversized using hitSlop to ensure responsive pickups.
